scope: test-only N5 serial stack fixture setup corrections

causes_and_corrections.cause: Column.walls stores layer indices (0/1), while the first report draft indexed wall policy APIs with marker IDs (0/3); top-wall marker 3 could be out of range.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Resolve each marker through existing layerOfMarker and invert that map for per-column labels; emit per-wall statistics under the physical marker IDs.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The first report draft represented first-height behavior only with HeightOk pass/error summaries and configured h0 values.
causes_and_corrections.correction: After the existing completion/growth sequence, collect rows.lift base-to-lift pairs on each existing wall marker and report measured absolute z displacement samples, min/max/mean, and missing base-vertex counts. Empty measurements carry an explicit unavailable status.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The first M10 modes reused the requested M12 two-wall/all-symmetry geometry, which did not preserve the smallest existing one-wall synthetic-box baseline.
causes_and_corrections.correction: M10 n1/n2/n4 now use the original one-wall SyntheticBox defaults and original marker roles; only M12 control/meet modes enable the two-wall, four-distinct-symmetry-side fixture.

causes_and_corrections.cause: A column stopHeight can be infinite when no finite stop height was recorded, which is not valid JSON as a raw floating-point token.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Serialize nonfinite report doubles as JSON null with the test-only D9Number helper.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The first stack formatter treated Column.walls entries as physical marker IDs although they are layer indices; the initial M10 report also did not preserve configured-wall scope in its by-wall section.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Map layer indices back to wall markers for column output and use layerOfMarker to read per-wall h0/growth/thickness and aggregate each wall's column stacks.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The first implementation kept measurement, report assembly, and test dispatch in a long dense test block.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Split the test-only work into D9Columns, D9FirstHeights, D9MeshStats, D9RoomStats, D9Report, and D9Measure helpers; formatted only the new source range with clang-format.

primary_nonfinite_quality_correction.cause: NaN q/J comparisons would not count as bad in new writer.
primary_nonfinite_quality_correction.correction: Count nonfinite values as bad; original thresholds unchanged.

compile_WallFaces_API.cause: Build511: new first-height reporter assumed WallFaces returns face structs with out/marker; actual API returns (cell ID, sorted face).
compile_WallFaces_API.correction: Read its actual owning cell, match physical slot by sorted face, obtain marker through unchanged reference, and use pair.second vertices. Production unchanged; failed80.177s build receipts/pins/source copies preserved.

runtime_direction_setup_and_growth_recei.cause: M10n2 reachedtwoGrowthlayers thenproductioncurrent_front threw afterboundary_revision changed. New fixture differed from productioncaller: it installed a one-time direction pointer without ensureDirectionField revision refresh; uncaught production stops also lost all partial measurement receipts.
runtime_direction_setup_and_growth_recei.correction: Install the existing production-style synchronous revision refresh callback. Record an explicit G exception/null unavailable growth-object data and committed-state/phase-log evidence if the unchanged production guard still stops; never bypass guard or claim accepted BL.
